info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/flux-2-lora-gallery/multiple-angles
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/flux-2-lora-gallery/multiple-angles queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Generate different camera angles using <sks> trigger word system.

Automatically builds prompt from horizontal_angle, vertical_angle, and zoom sliders.
Format: <sks> [angle_description] [elevation_description] [distance_description]

Flux2LoraGalleryMultipleAnglesInput.description: Input model for Multiple Angles endpoint - Camera control with precise adjustments using <sks> trigger word. Prompt is built automatically from slider values.
Flux2LoraGalleryMultipleAnglesInput.title: MultipleAnglesInput

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the output image.

zoom.title: Zoom (Distance)
zoom.description: Camera zoom/distance. 0=wide shot (far away), 5=medium shot (normal), 10=close-up (very close).

horizontal_angle.title: Horizontal Angle (Azimuth °)
horizontal_angle.description: Horizontal rotation angle around the object in degrees. 0°=front view, 90°=right side, 180°=back view, 270°=left side, 360°=front view again.

image_urls.description: The URL of the image to adjust camera angle for.
image_urls.title: Image URLs

vertical_angle.title: Vertical Angle (Elevation °)
vertical_angle.description: Vertical camera angle in degrees. 0°=eye-level shot, 30°=elevated shot, 60°=high-angle shot (looking down from above).

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If True, the media will be returned as a data URI.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Whether to enable the safety checker. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

lora_scale.title: Lora Scale
lora_scale.description: The strength of the multiple angles effect.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: The size of the generated image. If not provided, the size of the input image will be used.

images.description: The generated images with multiple camera angles
images.title: Images

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
